panels.description: Users who signed in within the window (the last login is refreshed when the frontend starts). A count, never names.

panels.description: Users who signed in within the window (the last login is refreshed when the frontend starts). A count, never names.

panels.title: Open sessions
panels.description: Open collaboration WebSockets (members and guests).

panels.title: Boards being edited
panels.description: Boards with at least one open session.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: The three windows over time (24 h, 7 d, 30 d).

panels.title: Open sessions and boards being edited
Updates per second
panels.description: Accepted Yjs updates of all boards.

panels.title: Size of an update (p50 / p95 / p99)
Dropped updates by reason
panels.description: Role, size, rate ... (see collab-protocol.md). A rise for no reason in production points to broken clients.

panels.title: Closed sessions by code
panels.description: WebSocket close codes: 4403 access withdrawn, 4408 idle, 1001 restart ...

panels.title: Storage by kind
panels.description: snapshot and log: the drawing (collab); files: uploads including converted PDFs. Read every five minutes.

panels.title: Uploads by result (range)
panels.description: accepted, type_not_allowed, quota_exceeded, too_large, rate_limited, infected, error.

panels.title: Conversions by result (range)
panels.description: Office to PDF by Gotenberg: done or failed.

panels.title: Malware scans by result
panels.description: clean, infected, too_large (a file above clamav-max-bytes: 413 when failing closed, else accepted unscanned) and unavailable (clamd down, too slow, an error, a blob that could not be opened). Without a scanner (no DRAWBOARD_CLAMAV_HOST) the series do not exist. A fail-open deployment with clamd down only shows 'unavailable' here: the alert svc-drawboard-scan-unavailable watches it.

panels.title: Active links (signed in)
panels.description: Links that are neither revoked nor expired.

panels.title: Guest sessions (range)
panels.description: Guest sessions that were started or renewed. The token is stateless, so the server cannot tell how many are open right now.

panels.title: Link exchanges by result
panels.description: signed_in, guest, or the reason it failed (not_found, password, rate_limited ...).

panels.title: Rounds (range)
panels.description: started, revealed, cancelled.

panels.title: Votes (range)
panels.description: Votes stored, changed ones too. Never a value.

panels.title: Refused (range)
panels.description: rate_limit: 429 from the rates of S7.3; round_full: the participant cap of a round was reached.
